description: Fork of exp071 testing the 'combinatorial-embedding' hypothesis: shrink E to 64 (was 96) but saturate pair coverage in all 3 LUT modules. d_qk=32, d_v=32, n_heads=6 → H*d_v=192 (out_proj input). All modules use nap=8 for 4-8x table-capacity-vs-n_outputs. Pair coverage: qk 101% per head (tph=256), v 101% (tph=256), out 101% (tph=2304). Per-input-dim coverage: ~64 for qk/v, ~192 for out_proj. Per-layer LUT: qk 25.17M, v 12.58M, out 37.75M = 75.5M. 6 layers: 453M LUT + ~15M (token+pos+unembedder) = ~468M total. Tests whether smaller E + saturated tables beats wider E + sparse tables.
